title: Admin Connector read-only Staging/MCP recovery and bounded developer sessions

phases.objective: Provide disabled-by-default independent Admin Recovery diagnostic failover to fixed Staging and MCP hosts when Production is genuinely unavailable, and a bounded allowlisted local developer workflow with exact-head fencing and no secret inheritance.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Production 401/403 and healthy responses do not trigger failover. Production 5xx or transport unavailability enables only a read-only fixed-host Staging health/MCP diagnostic; MCP data requires a distinct Staging OAuth token, and no write tool or credential crossover is permitted.
steps: Probe the fixed Production health endpoint and deny health, auth or redirect-based false failovers.
On a real 5xx/transport outage, request fixed Staging health or MCP metadata only.
For MCP catalog/read-only tools, require Staging resource-scoped OAuth, preserve read-only tool allowlist and return bounded output.
assertions: No automatic environment rebinding or production credential replay.
Only dev.mad4b.com and mcp-dev.mad4b.com are reached.
No caller-selected URL/host/method, redirects, arbitrary MCP tools or Production writes.
Fail closed for missing or invalid Staging resource token.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only an explicitly configured allowlisted repo supports limited Git actions and opted-in exact-head Node tests, with bounded session status and cancel; subprocesses do not inherit platform secrets.
steps: Check opt-in feature flags and canonical repo path against file allowlist.
Start an allowlisted task, rejecting arbitrary commands and path traversal.
Verify exact Git head before running repository code.
Return bounded output cursors, completion and cancellation status.
assertions: No raw shell, arbitrary file execution or cross-repo path.
No connector, Production or Cloudflare secret inheritance.
Session execution requires explicit opt-in and exact-head fencing.
In-process resumability does not claim durable execution after service restart.
